# KickALL Ecosystem - AI Agent Documentation

## Overview
KickALL is an all-in-one streaming ecosystem and SaaS platform designed specifically for Kick.com live streamers. The ecosystem comprises four specialized studios: Kickot (Chatbot & Moderation), Kickaj (Giveaways & Wheel of Fortune), Kickan (Stream Telemetry & Analytics), and Kickov (OBS Overlays & Alerts).

## Core Studios

### 1. Kickot (Chatbot & Auto-Moderation Studio)
- **URL**: https://kickall.app/kickot/
- **Purpose**: Autonomous chatbot and intelligent auto-moderation for Kick channels.
- **Key Features**:
  - Automated chat moderation: Caps protection, link filtering with domain whitelist, bad words detection with Unicode normalization (anti-raid evasion), emote limits, symbol limits, and duplicate spam filters.
  - Custom commands engine with dynamic template variables: `{user}`, `{touser}`, `{channel}`, `{random.X-Y}`.
  - Role-based permissions: Broadcaster, Moderator, VIP, Subscriber, Everyone.
  - Mini-games & Chat Economy: Coinflip, Slots, Roulette, and customizable currency.
  - Automated timed announcements with configurable message thresholds.
  - Watchtime tracking and real-time chat leaderboards.
  - Song requests with YouTube search integration.
  - Multi-channel manager delegation.

### 2. Kickaj (Giveaway & Wheel of Fortune Studio)
- **URL**: https://kickall.app/kickaj/
- **Purpose**: Live giveaway automation and interactive drawing animations.
- **Key Features**:
  - Multi-animation drawing modes: Customizable 3D Canvas Wheel of Fortune, Slot Machine, and Casino Roulette.
  - Automated participant entry tracking via keyword in Kick live chat.
  - Follower verification and minimum follow-duration checks.
  - Subscriber bonus luck multipliers.
  - Dual confirmation system: Chat confirmation timer with fallback auto-redraw.
  - Export winner logs and full audit trails in chronological order.

### 3. Kickan (Stream Telemetry & Analytics Studio)
- **URL**: https://kickall.app/kickan/
- **Purpose**: Channel telemetry, viewer retention, and stream growth metrics.
- **Key Features**:
  - Live viewer count tracking and concurrent audience graphs.
  - Chat activity velocity and peak message frequency.
  - Stream session history and historical performance comparisons.

### 4. Kickov (OBS Overlay & Alert Studio)
- **URL**: https://kickall.app/kickov/
- **Purpose**: Dynamic browser source stream overlays for OBS Studio and Streamlabs.
- **Key Features**:
  - Real-time stream alerts: Follows, subscriptions, gifts, and host raids.
  - Fully customizable CSS styling, animations, and sound effects.
  - Low-latency Supabase Realtime broadcast integration.

## Technical Architecture

### Frontend
- Pure Vanilla JavaScript (ES2022+), CSS3 with modern design tokens and variables, HTML5 semantic structure.
- Progressive Web App (PWA) enabled with Service Worker offline caching.
- Accessible UI compliant with WCAG 2.2 AA (reduced motion support, high-contrast states, keyboard navigation).
- Bi-lingual internationalization: English (`en`) and Serbian Latin (`sr`) with automatic language detection and persistence.

### Backend & API
- Node.js bot service running with fail-closed authentication (`X-Internal-Token` / `Authorization: Bearer`).
- Netlify Serverless Functions for API proxying, OAuth token exchange, and Fungies webhook processing.
- Atomic PostgreSQL RPC functions (`check_rate_limit`, `get_managed_kick_channels`) on Supabase.
- Row Level Security (RLS) enabled on all database tables.
- Real-time bidirectional communication via WebSocket (Kick Pusher) and Supabase Realtime CDC.
